newsitem.title: USA: CTS completes tender for Dynamics, WHX weighs options.
newsitem.headline: CTS completes tender for Dynamics, WHX weighs options.

text.p: CTS Corp. said Monday it completed its offer to purchase the common stock of Dynamics Corp. of America for $56.25 a share in cash.

Separately, steelmaker WHX Corp. said it would consider its options after its own $56-a-share offer to acquire Dynamics, which makes electronic components and air conditioning equipment, expired Friday.
According to CTS, 1,164,339 Dynamics shares, or 30.3 percent of the company's outstanding shares, were tendered and accepted for payment by CTS.

Subject to approval of Dynamics and CTS shareholders and other customary conditions, each Dynamics share not purchased in the tender offer will be converted into 0.88 CTS common share. Dynamics will become a wholly owned subsidiary of CTS.
The companies said they expect the merger to be completed this summer.
Dynamics currently holds a 44.0 percent stake in CTS.

Under the Dynamics-CTS deal, CTS is entitled to representation proportionate to its equity stake in Dynamics. Accordingly, CTS said it requested that Dynamics' board be increased to 13 by the addition of four CTS designees.

WHX, which owns 13.5 percent of Dynamics, said in a statement that it is considering whether to discuss a merger with Dynamics and CTS, or appeal to Dynamics stockholders directly through a proxy solicitation, a new tender offer, or both.
CTS and Dynamics make electronic components.
CTS's stock climbed $2.125 to $67.25, Dynamics rose $1.50 to $58, and WHX fell 25 cents to $7.25 on the New York Stock Exchange.
